bom.name: chassis
bom.notes: Primary structural backbone; includes chassis pegs for track pods

bom.name: track pod LH
bom.notes: Left track pod; seats on chassis pegs before wheels/axles

bom.name: track pod RH
bom.notes: Right track pod; mirror of LH; seats on chassis pegs

bom.name: road wheel
bom.notes: Axle-bore critical; requires hole compensation pairing with axle pins

bom.name: axle C-clip
bom.notes: Retainer for axle/clip pairs; print thin walls; verify snap over axle groove

bom.name: axle pin
bom.notes: Male mating feature for wheels/sprockets/C-clips; scale OD vs hole_comp

bom.name: drive sprocket
bom.notes: Engages track segments; axle bore tolerance-critical

bom.name: track segment
bom.notes: Closed-loop track chain; 12 per side typical

bom.name: clicker leaf
bom.notes: Fatigue-resistant flexure; MUST be PETG (not PLA)

bom.name: turret
bom.notes: Rotates on chassis turret ring after drivetrain assemble

bom.name: hatch cover
bom.notes: Final cosmetic/access cover on chassis or turret

print_notes.structural: PLA — chassis, pods, wheels, sprockets, turret, barrel, hatch
print_notes.tolerance: Axle pins, C-clips, wheel/sprocket bores: print hole-compensation calibration set first
